sloka: स विह्वलित सर्व अंगो गत बुद्धिः विचेतनः ।निषसाद आतुरो दीनो निःश्वस्य अशीतम् आयतम् ॥३-६१-२८॥
transliteration: sa vihvalita sarva aṁgo gata buddhiḥ vicetanaḥ ।niṣasāda āturo dīno niḥśvasya aśītam āyatam ॥3-61-28॥

translations.english: Thus tormented by the abduction of Sita, Rama felt dejected and cried.Overpowered by grief he lost his consciousness for a moment.
